summary: 016 resolves D04-R002-003 exactly: after every actually executed Full Test check, the host re-derives the trusted candidate and stops immediately before any later check when candidate identity drifts. The new two-check counterexample proves the later side-effecting check never runs. The correction is limited to one local execution boundary and one test; all other accepted Full Test semantics remain unchanged.
